name: Kasshoku Kyonyuu no Onna Senshi Marguerite no Junan!?
original_name: 褐色巨乳の女戦士・マルグリットの受難!?
source: The protagonist attends adventure school as a pharmacist along side his childhood friend, Marguerite, who attends as a warrior. During a training mission to retrieve a treasure from a ruin, Marguerite set off a trap that ended up with her and the protagonist getting cursed. Along the way, they both must do trials -- from acting like a couple, to sexual acts. Will they break the curse?
translation: 主人公以药剂师的身份和青梅竹马玛格丽特一起就读于冒险学校，玛格丽特以战士身份入学。在一次从遗迹中取回宝物的训练任务中，玛格丽特触发了陷阱，导致她和主人公都受到了诅咒。一路上，他们必须完成各种试炼——从扮演情侣到性行为。他们能打破诅咒吗？
